svg.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Every branch and merge in grand, 2019 to 2026
69 branches over 7 years, oldest at the top. Context for the recovery rather than part of it: most of these no longer exist.
dashed: in the trunk, but no merge commit names it
amber with no line out: forked and never came back
